business_problem: Fenrir needed to replace an expensive overprovisioned internal e-commerce platform that still failed during traffic spikes, especially around promotions, while preserving customer-data security and supporting Japanese customization needs on EC-CUBE.
solution_summary: Fenrir worked with Alibaba Cloud to build a new e-commerce platform that combines EC-CUBE with elastic cloud infrastructure tuned for sudden bursts of shopping traffic. Elastic Compute Service provides the main application servers for storefront and order-processing workloads, while Application Load Balancer spreads traffic across multiple instances so promotions, anniversary events, and product launches do not overwhelm a single node. PolarDB and ApsaraDB for Redis handle persistent transactional data and low-latency caching, File Storage NAS covers shared file needs, NAT Gateway manages external connectivity, and Auto Scaling expands or contracts capacity with the business cycle. The design focuses on network and compute scalability so the company no longer has to size the entire platform around rare peaks, yet can still respond quickly when traffic surges. In practice, Alibaba Cloud gave Fenrir a more resilient and cost-aware commerce architecture that better fits rapid traffic growth in Japan.
business_outcome: Fenrir delivered a new EC platform that can absorb promotional spikes with better stability and lower structural overprovisioning.

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service
solution_components.role: Runs the main e-commerce application servers that handle storefront traffic and orders.

solution_components.name: Application Load Balancer
solution_components.role: Distributes shopper requests across multiple servers during traffic surges.

solution_components.name: PolarDB
solution_components.role: Stores persistent relational data for the e-commerce platform.

solution_components.name: ApsaraDB for Redis
solution_components.role: Caches hot application data for low-latency shopping flows.

solution_components.name: File Storage NAS
solution_components.role: Provides shared file storage for the platform environment.

solution_components.name: NAT Gateway
solution_components.role: Manages external network access for services in the cloud environment.

solution_components.name: Auto Scaling
solution_components.role: Adjusts server capacity in response to traffic fluctuations.

data_flow: Shopper traffic reaches the site through Application Load Balancer, is processed by ECS application servers, reads and writes state in PolarDB and Redis, stores shared assets on NAS, and expands elastically through Auto Scaling when promotional traffic climbs.
